answer: The ocean counter is kept in signal and shale exposes each reset. An adversary as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 46 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
